title: Abelian surfaces over totally real fields are potentially modular
summary: An independently reviewed target-level plan of ordinary parallel-weight-two GSp₄ lifting and its potential automorphy/modularity consequences for abelian surfaces. Eight stages remain planned, with ten explicit gaps, including the defect-one flat-quotient action. Existing upstream and supplier targets are imported; no formalization or proof closure is asserted.
readme:
This roadmap owns the BCGP final argument and selected BCGP25 inputs, at target level: H¹ and modularity conventions, the Taylor–Wiles set-up, ordinary Hida–Hecke Galois representations, patching, multiplicities, gluing, potential modularity/automorphy and modularity applications. The detailed reader gives every statement, hypothesis, proof route, API and definition test.

Review accepted 2026-10-18 as a plan with explicit gaps: 57 targets, 17 pinned baseline declarations, 127 API items, 71 tests, 31 planets, 98 supplier requests, ten gaps and zero closed stages. A proof using defect-one patched-MCM is conditional on its unproved action through the maximal O-flat quotient (G-flatness); no assertion of O-flatness is supplied by balancedness. Other supplier gaps propagate through dependencies.

Existing current upstream IntegralHeckeAndGaloisDeterminants owns reductive pseudocharacters, reconstruction, localization and integral interpolation; SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups owns spin-polynomial conventions and positive Klingen Hecke theory. Import them. Only the missing affinoid, Hilbert–Siegel, local/newform and comparison extensions are requested. Exact existing atlas nodes for local ordinary rings, residual image, isobaric sums, ordinary rank-two lifting and polarized finite-level lifting are imported rather than replanned.

Conventions: H¹ has inverse cyclotomic multiplier and residual representation dual to torsion; forms have central character |·|². Curve zeta reflection is s↦2−s, versus s↦3−s for the abelian surface. All CM endomorphisms over the base give an isobaric Hecke-character sum; a cuspidal GL₂ conclusion requires the corrected endomorphism hypothesis. Arthur-dependent arguments retain their stated conditional input. All sources and results are paraphrased, with exact theorem/section/page locators in the reader.

stages.title: Abelian surfaces, automorphy and weight 2 Galois representations
stages.description: Targets: The GSp_4-valued compatible system of an abelian surface; Automorphic compatible systems over a number field; Automorphic and potentially automorphic abelian varieties; Modular and potentially modular GSp_4-representations and abelian surfaces; Galois representations of ordinary parallel weight 2 forms on GSp_4. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route.

stages.title: The Taylor–Wiles set-up for GSp_4 over a totally real field
stages.description: Targets: The standing hypotheses on ρ̄ and the auxiliary place v_0; The global deformation problems S_χ^{I,𝔠} and S_{χ,Q}^{I,𝔠}; The tame levels K^p, K_0^p(Q), K_1^p(Q) and K_0^p(Q,R); Weights of Λ_I, classical weights, κ_2 and κ_reg; The Hida–Hecke modules M^{χ,I,𝔠} and M^{χ,I,𝔠,Q} and their Hecke algebras; Proposition 7.8.11: freeness in defect 0 and balancedness in defect 1. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route.

stages.title: Galois representations on ordinary Hida–Hecke algebras
stages.description: Targets: Proposition 7.9.1: the doubling surjections M^{χ,I,𝔠} ⊗ Λ_{I'} → M^{χ,I',𝔠}; Theorem 7.9.4: Galois representations over the Hida–Hecke algebras; Corollary 7.9.6: refined Galois representations of ordinary weight 2 forms; Proposition 7.9.8: Δ_Q-coinvariants of the Taylor–Wiles modules. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route.

stages.title: Patching in defect zero and one
stages.description: Targets: The patched objects S_∞, R_∞^{·,I,𝔠}, M_∞^{·,I,𝔠} and the dimension identity; Proposition 7.11.2: the patched modules are maximal Cohen–Macaulay. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route. Routes using defect-one patched-MCM are conditional on G-flatness.

stages.title: Ihara avoidance and multiplicities
stages.description: Targets: Hypothesis 7.13.1 on ρ and the levels K^{p,Iw}, K^{p,Iw_1}; The primes 𝔭_x, 𝔭̃_{x'}^{I,𝔠} and the eigenspaces S^{I,𝔠}_{κ}; Proposition 7.13.5: Iwahori invariants of generic L-packets on components of Spec R_v^1; Proposition 7.13.9: the doubling injection from Klingen to Iwahori level; Proposition 7.13.11: dimensions of eigenspaces in regular weight and in weight κ_2; Theorem 7.13.6: the ρ-eigenspace has dimension 8d_ρ when #I ≤ 1. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route. Routes using defect-one patched-MCM are conditional on G-flatness.

stages.title: Gluing, étale descent and the modularity lifting theorems
stages.description: Targets: Lemmas 8.2.3 and 8.2.5: analytic continuation and étale descent of the glued forms; Lemmas 8.2.7–8.2.11: connected components and the superspecial locus; Theorem 8.2.1: the ρ-eigenspace has dimension 8d_ρ for every I; Corollary 8.2.2: a representation satisfying Hypothesis 7.13.1 is modular; Lemma 8.3.2: solvable descent of modularity; Theorem 8.4.1: the main modularity lifting theorem; Twisted p-distinguished weight 2 ordinary representations and twisted ordinary π_p; Theorem 8.5.2: modularity lifting with relaxed multiplier. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route. Routes using defect-one patched-MCM are conditional on G-flatness.

stages.title: Potential modularity and potential automorphy of abelian surfaces
stages.description: Targets: Galois types of abelian surfaces and challenging surfaces; Proposition 9.2.1: surfaces not of type A or B[C_2] are potentially automorphic; Lemma 9.2.2: big residual image for challenging surfaces; Good primes for an abelian surface; Lemmas 9.2.5–9.2.6: good primes have density one, and the auxiliary pair p, q; Twisted moduli of principally polarized abelian surfaces with fixed torsion; Fixed-determinant GL_2(F_q)-extensions with prescribed local behaviour; Lemma 9.2.7 (corrected): the p–q switching lemma; Theorem 9.2.8: challenging abelian surfaces are potentially modular; Theorem 2.7.3: Galois representations for weight 0 forms on GL_2 over a quadratic extension of a totally real field; Theorem 9.3.1 (Theorem 1.1.3): every abelian surface over a totally real field is potentially automorphic; Corollary 9.3.3 and Theorem 1.1.2: the Hasse–Weil conjecture for genus two curves and abelian surfaces; Theorem 9.3.4 (Theorem 1.1.4): genus one curves over quadratic extensions of totally real fields are potentially modular; Proposition 9.4.1: the Hasse–Weil conjecture for Kummer surfaces. Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route. Routes using defect-one patched-MCM are conditional on G-flatness.

stages.title: Modularity, fixed 3-torsion and the paramodular conjecture
stages.description: Targets: Proposition 10.1.1 (Theorem 1.1.7): modularity of ordinary abelian surfaces; Proposition 10.1.3: three cases in which ρ̄_p is ordinarily modular; Lemmas 7.5.25–7.5.27: crossing with dihedral extensions; Theorem 10.1.4: modularity of elliptic curves over quadratic extensions via mod 5; The Burkhardt quartic, the odd-theta cover P and its twists P(ρ̄); Corollary 9.3.6 and Lemma 9.3.7 of BCGP25: local realization at 3 by genus two curves with a rational Weierstrass point; Theorem 10.2.1 (corrected): abelian surfaces with fixed 3-torsion; Theorem 10.2.6 (Theorem 1.1.5): infinitely many modular abelian surfaces with trivial endomorphisms; Lemma 10.3.1: the paramodular conjecture for ordinary surfaces; The paramodular conjecture and its modification (Brumer–Kramer); Lemma 10.3.2: motives attached to symplectic GL_4 forms, conditionally; §10.4: fake abelian surfaces and an explicit genus two curve over Q(√−6). Every conclusion inherits the hypotheses and recorded gaps along its proof route. Routes using defect-one patched-MCM are conditional on G-flatness. Local seeds retain the polarized lifting gap; the explicit quaternionic example retains its CM certificate requirement; conjectures are stated as hypotheses or propositions.

review.notes: Independent review of all 57 targets, all 17 pinned baseline declarations, all 18 definition/construction APIs and 71 tests, supplier statements, source locators and editions, current upstream overlap and the light Suggested file. Corrections were applied in place. Acceptance is of an honest target-level plan with ten explicit gaps and conditional proof chains; none of its eight stages is closed and every implementation flag remains unchecked. No nodes were added. See the review report for the full audit and limitations.
